title: 'Can I really do this?': Neets speak to BBC about struggling to get a job
originalTitle: 'Can I really do this?': Neets speak to BBC about struggling to get a job
content:
A government-backed review has proposed wide-ranging measures to help get young people into work.

The BBC spoke to young people not in education, employment or training - also known as Neets - about their experiences trying to find jobs.

Read more about the Milburn review.
